user.title: Set up Ladekönig
user.description: Finds the cheapest ad-hoc charging price within the selected area. Data source: operators' AFIR reports via the German Mobilithek.

data_description.location: Set centre and radius (max. 50 km) on the map.
data_description.operators: Optional, comma-separated, e.g. "Tesla" or "EnBW, Ionity". Empty = all.
data_description.location_entity: Optional: the search moves with this entity, e.g. your car (device_tracker) or a person. Without a current position the location above is used. The radius always comes from the search area.

error.radius_too_large: The radius must not exceed 50 km.
error.radius_too_small: The radius must be at least 500 m.
